searchText: Not sure if this is relevant, but last time I was testing is Lighthouse down-score Grandine with invalid proposal slot error for the next epoch proposer preferences Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Rejected gossip proposer preferences error: "InvalidProposalSlot { validator_index: 157, proposal_slot: Slot(16) }", proposal_slot: 16, validator_index: 157 Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Rejected gossip proposer preferences error: "InvalidProposalSlot { validator_index: 208, proposal_slot: Slot(17) }", proposal_slot: 17, validator_index: 208 Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Peer score adjusted msg: invalid_gossip_proposer_preferences, peer_id: 16Uiu2HAmVAeuYZtJFjqLYMFdKADHDwu5WuABk22YSDuHaxzEBjNc, score: -9.99 Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Peer score adjusted msg: invalid_gossip_proposer_preferences, peer_id: 16Uiu2HAmVAeuYZtJFjqLYMFdKADHDwu5WuABk22YSDuHaxzEBjNc, score: -19.99 Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Successfully verified gossip proposer preferences proposal_slot: 9, validator_index: 163 Jun 03 09:16:53.006 DEBUG Successfully verified gossip proposer preferences proposal_slot: 12, validator_index: 161 This happen at the start of epoch 1, Lighthouse accept the current epoch but reject the next epoch, I was running with minimal preset So Grandine has to broadcast just the current epoch to avoid being down scored by lighthouse While other clients didn’t reject those messages
